title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 2 November 2026
description: Credit markets grow nervous about AI debt as default insurance costs hit record highs, Australian home values post their fastest decline in decades ahead of the RBA's next rate call, Queensland's tourism economy hits a record $45.6 billion, and a Gold Coast FOI dispute reignites scrutiny of the mayor's Mar-a-Lago stay. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
